title: Ethswitch Moves To Enable International Card Payments In Ethiopia
summary: EthSwitch S.C., operator of Ethiopia’s national payment infrastructure, has opened an international settlement account with Bank of Abyssinia as part of efforts to connect the country’s payment system with global card networks.

title: Fiscal Year
summary: The Ministry of Revenues collected Birr 1.518 trillion during the 2025/26 fiscal year, exceeding the government’s revised annual revenue target.

title: Ethiopia Siinqee Bank Reports Birr 107 Billion Pre Provision Profit
summary: Siinqee Bank reported a pre-provision profit of Birr 10.7 billion for the 2025/26 fiscal year, according to figures presented during the bank’s annual operational review held at the Ethiopian Skylight Hotel.

title: Imf Expects Ethiopias Foreign Exchange Reserves To Near Usd 6 Billion As Reform Program Advances
summary: Ethiopia’s foreign exchange reserves are projected to approach USD 6 billion by the end of the 2025/26 fiscal year, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), reflecting continued progress under the country’s ongoing economic reform program.

title: Dbe To Disburse 31 Million Euro In Concessional Loans To Conflict Affected Msmes
summary: The Development Bank of Ethiopia (DBE) is preparing to disburse a 31 million euro concessional loan package to micro, small and medium enterprises operating in conflict affected areas of the country.
